statement: A replica removal settlement may fence or mark FAILED only the exact runtime and durable lifecycle generation whose applied membership it observed; stale membership, status retries, queued effects and late failures must preserve an ACTIVE successor and retain owner-defined retry debt.

constraints.statement: Capture the exact tracked runtime and lifecycle-owner full source evidence before membership awaits; keep that same observation across retry. The status-write owner and existing lifecycle CAS own conditional persistence and local publication/rollback.

Only the removal-settlement/status interaction, smallest existing lifecycle persistence effect seam, current native/direct owner witnesses, interaction registration and canonical generated artifacts may change. Keep Hypatia role/startup and Huygens R5 cleanup-receipt work distinct; no foreign worktree writes.

Exercise the real subscription, real native membership answer, un-intercepted production status writer, ACTIVE successor control and concurrent removal. A write intent spy is not successor safety proof. State the lifecycle-store fixture ceiling and retain all first failures.

No fallback, new scheduler, timeout or baseline increases. Scoped thermal/flock tests only; preserve any unexpected verification failure and hand back to Astra. No commits, push, integration, landing or publication in this sidecar.
